content:
maria: FYI vendor Asterix Cloud sent invoice AC-3319 with no PO on header and remittance instructions to a different entity. Total $8,450. PDF: https://redwood-drive/finance/invoices/AC-3319.pdf

approvals-bot: Invoice received (inv_20240402_4021). Flags detected: missing_po, vendor_name_mismatch. Routed to ryan_fin by default.

ryan_fin: Pulling the file. Invoice payee != vendor record (Asterix Cloud LLC vs Asterix Cloud Inc). Can procurement confirm which vendor entity and whether a PO exists? Also advise on remittance bank details.

procurement-bot: Searching POs for Asterix... Candidate PO 3330 (Asterix Cloud Inc) committed amount $7,200. Candidate PO 3331 (Asterix Cloud LLC) closed. Three-way check: invoice $8,450 vs PO 3330 $7,200. Flagging @ellie_proc.

ellie_proc: On it. Looks like vendor sent invoice to legacy payee; the work was delivered under PO 3330 for $7,200. Extra $1,250 appears to be travel/expenses not in SOW. Ops needs to confirm authorized expenses and updated payee. @ops-bot can you pull expense approvals?

ops-bot: No expense approvals found for invoice AC-3319. Change requests: 0. Travel expenses for this engagement were not pre-approved.

ryan_fin: I'll place the invoice on hold (HOLD_INV_1969991234). Note: vendor payee mismatch + $1,250 unapproved expenses. Do not remit until resolved.

ellie_proc: Procurement to contact vendor AR to (1) reissue invoice to the correct legal entity matching PO 3330, and (2) either provide expense receipts with approvals or issue a credit memo for $1,250. Also ask vendor to reference PO 3330 on the invoice. Deadline 72 hours.

maria: I've emailed ar@asterixcloud.com and CC'd vendor manager. Included: PO number, request to correct payee, and ask for backup for expenses.

ryan_fin: AP note added: "HOLD - missing PO reference; vendor entity mismatch; unapproved expenses $1,250. Contacted vendor for corrected invoice or credit memo. Escalate to vendor manager if no reply in 72h."

procurement-bot: Audit tag added: audit_55312. Routing to ellie_proc for follow-up.

ellie_proc: Will update thread after vendor response. If vendor provides receipts with approvals, we can consider partial release for $7,200 and hold $1,250 until approvals provided. :hourglass:
